findings.message: Codex review of TASK-027 implementation confirms all acceptance criteria are met. Tiered hinting with scaffold levels 1-3 is properly implemented with full-solution guardrails.

Adaptive difficulty system via _build_adaptive_guidance() uses session context (recent_failures, recent_successes, stuck_seconds, age band) to compute gentle adjustments. The recommended_hint_level clamping (1-3) prevents abrupt difficulty changes.
Full-solution detection via _looks_like_full_solution() effectively prevents revealing complete answers. Fallback hint substitution maintains helpfulness while avoiding solution spoilage.

Quest suggestion system (_build_adaptive_quest) generates contextual guidance. All companion metadata (difficulty_adjustment, quest_suggestion, reveals_full_solution) is properly integrated into execute output.
Failsafe and model-unavailable paths preserve functionality with rules-based fallback. Adaptive metadata continues to work even when LLM is unavailable.
Test coverage is comprehensive. run_task_027_tests.gd passes with 12 checks, and regression validation via run_task_032_tests.gd passes with 51 checks. No failures reported.
Handoff documentation (TASK-027-handoff-to-claude.md) is thorough and maps all acceptance criteria to implementation details. Validation results are clearly documented.

acceptance_criteria.adaptive_difficulty_gentle: PASS - Difficulty adapts gently using session context with appropriate clamping

checklist.hexagonal_architecture: PASS - Service properly extends port and uses injected dependencies (LLMPort, ModerationPort, etc.)
checklist.safety: PASS - HINT_SCAFFOLD_GUARD event and full-solution detection provide appropriate safety measures

summary: APPROVE. TASK-027 codex review and implementation are both complete and correct. All acceptance criteria are met: tiered hinting avoids full solutions, adaptive difficulty uses session context gently. The codex review is thorough and the copilot cross review confirms all findings. TASK-027 is ready to proceed to next dependencies.
